Subject: Renewal reminder for your library loan

Hi Priya,

This is a courtesy reminder that your loan of "The Cartographer's Daughter" (barcode 4471920) is due back at the Elmwood branch on the 28th. You can renew it once online; after that a small overdue fee applies. I noticed you'd asked our chat assistant about renewal limits last week, and it correctly quoted the two-renewal cap, so you're still within it. If you'd like the assistant to text you a reminder two days before the due date, just reply and I'll switch it on. No rush — the branch desk is open until 7 on weekdays.
